import heapq

def minimumCostPath(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (grid[0][0], 0, 0))
    visited = [[False for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    visited[0][0] = True
    min_cost = [[float('inf')] * n for _ in range(n)]
    min_cost[0][0] = grid[0][0]

    while heap:
        current_cost, i, j = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if i == n - 1 and j == n - 1:
            return current_cost
        if current_cost > min_cost[i][j]:
            continue
        for di, dj in directions:
            ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
            if 0 <= ni < n and 0 <= nj < n:
                new_cost = current_cost + grid[ni][nj]
                if new_cost < min_cost[ni][nj]:
                    min_cost[ni][nj] = new_cost
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (new_cost, ni, nj))
    return min_cost[-1][-1]
